items.headline: Penn State no match for Northwestern in Ryan Field opener
items.description: Northwestern fans, who eagerly awaited Ryan Field's opening, were rewarded with not only an easy win over a preseason Top 25 team but also a light show and waves of fireworks and flames before kickoff of the Wildcats' 34-13 win over Penn State.

items.headline: Caleb Komolafe stars as Northwestern rushes past Penn State 34-13 in 1st game at Ryan Field
items.description: — Caleb Komolafe rushed for a career-high 188 yards and a touchdown, and Northwestern routed Penn State 34-13 on Friday night in the first game at the new Ryan Field.
